title: Tech Note: Communication Between Processes in 4D
author: Tai Bui, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: This is a comprehensive, still fully accurate reference on 4D's inter-process communication toolkit — interprocess variables, shared objects/collections, Storage, semaphores, workers, and signals are all current, unchanged 4D concurrency primitives. Nothing here has been deprecated; if anything, workers and shared objects/collections have only grown in importance as 4D's concurrency model has matured.
related_updates: All commands and patterns described (interprocess variables, Storage, shared objects/collections, semaphores, CALL WORKER, signals) remain current and are the standard 4D concurrency toolkit today
